child_list.content: Have a Fight

elements.content:
Emily: It’s my toy! Give it back!

Tom: No, I found it first. It’s mine now!

Emily: Stop being selfish! Share it with me!

Tom: No way! You’re always mean to me.

Mom: Please stop arguing! Fighting over a toy is not

right. You both need to apologize to each other.

Tom: I’m sorry, Emily. I should share the toy with

you.

Emily: I’m sorry, too. Let’s play it together.

Mom: Good job! Always remember to share with

others.

child_list.content: Hello, hello, hello

elements.content:
Hello, hello, hello. Hi, hi, hi.

Good morning to you, good morning to you.

It’s a beautiful day, let’s go out and play.

Good afternoon to you, good afternoon to you.

It’s a nice day, let’s whistle a tune.

Good evening to you, good evening to you.

It’s wonderful night, let’s dance in the moonlight

汤姆：不，我先找到它的。现在是我的

了！

艾米丽：别这么自私！和我分享一下！

汤姆：不行！你总是对我很凶。

这个玩具。

玩吧。

child_list.content: 你好，你好，你好
child_list.name: 题目

child_list.content:
你好，你好，你好。嗨，嗨，嗨。

早上好，早上好。

美好的一天，我们出去玩吧。

下午好，下午好。

美好的一天，让我们吹口哨吧。

晚上好，晚上好。

美好的夜晚，让我们在月光下跳舞吧。
